import json, openpyxl
from pathlib import Path
mani=json.loads(Path('inputs/manifest.json').read_text())
p=mani[0]['path']
wb=openpyxl.load_workbook(p, data_only=False)
print('sheets', [(ws.title, ws.sheet_state, ws.max_row, ws.max_column) for ws in wb.worksheets])
print('defined_names', list(wb.defined_names))
for sn in wb.sheetnames:
    ws=wb[sn]
    codes=[]
    for r in range(2, ws.max_row+1):
        a=ws.cell(r,1); b=ws.cell(r,2)
        codes.append(a.value)
        if r<4 or r==ws.max_row:
            print(sn, r, 'A', repr(a.value), a.data_type, a.number_format, '| B', repr(b.value), b.data_type, b.number_format, '| comment', a.comment, b.comment)
    print(sn, 'codes', sorted(codes), 'types', set(ws.cell(r,1).data_type for r in range(2, ws.max_row+1)))
    print(sn, 'comments any', [ (c.coordinate, c.comment.text) for row in ws.iter_rows() for c in row if c.comment ])
    print(sn, 'merged', ws.merged_cells.ranges, 'colwidths', {k:v.width for k,v in ws.column_dimensions.items()})
